# National Discovery Awards / The Discovery Exchange
# Primary Domain: https://nationaldiscoveryawards.com (Companion: https://thediscoveryexchange.com)

> No financial transactions will be welcomed until January 1st, 2027.
> OPEN PROJECT STILL UNDER CONSTRUCTION · FOR PUBLIC REVIEWS & CRITICISM ONLY.

## Core Mission & Architecture
- **The National Discovery Prize:** Empowering great public school teachers and working-class students (50% Student Education Fund, 25% Mentoring Teachers, 15% Classroom Tools, 10% Permanent Endowment).
- **Three Interlocked Foundations:** 1. Dexpa (70/30 Cooperative Debt-Free Real Estate), 2. The Discovery Marketplace (50/25/25 Online Garage Sale), and 3. Discovery Brick Coin (DBC, 100M Fixed Supply).
- **Open for Public Review & Walkthroughs:** Visitors and crawlers are welcome to read the Constitution, explore rooms, and test interactive walkthroughs. Live real-money billing remains off until launch.
